questions.question: What is the standard required nitrogen pressure test holding value for Daikin VRV refrigerant piping?
questions.explanation: Daikin engineering guidelines require a 3-stage pressure test reaching up to 4.15 MPa (601 psi) with nitrogen gas for 24 hours.

questions.question: What is the target vacuum level for system dehydration before charging refrigerant in VRV systems?
questions.explanation: Vacuum must reach and hold -755 mmHg (500 microns or lower) to boil off moisture.

questions.question: Which tool is officially utilized for Daikin VRV commissioning, error code diagnosis, and test running?
questions.explanation: Daikin Service Checker software and hardware interface is required for deep diagnostics and commissioning.

videoMetadataPresets.name: VRV Refnet Brazing & 4.15 MPa Nitrogen Test
requiredTools: Oxy-Acetylene Brazing Torch with Flashback Arrestors
Copper Tube Cutter, Reamer & Pipe Bender
safetyPrerequisites: Maintain continuous 0.02 MPa dry nitrogen sweep through copper lines during all brazing work

Wear brazing shade-5 goggles, heat-resistant leather gloves, and keep ABC fire extinguisher on site
